profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development and operation of Azure cloud services in C#, C++, and Javascript
Technical lead for junior software engineers

positions.title: Service Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Maintenance and support of Microsoft System Center 2012 Orchestrator. This includes:
o	Deploying new servers
o	Server upgrades and hotfixes
o	Troubleshooting server and network issues
o	Maintaining custom CSHTML health dashboard
o	Service account password resets 
o	Assisting with Runbook development
o	Internally developed PowerShell module

•	Maintaining internally developed SQL backed Customer Management Database 
o	Deploying new builds
o	Server and PowerShell module troubleshooting
o	Development of the web site, C# based PowerShell module, and SQL stored procedures
o	Service account password resets

•	Developing and maintaining automation
o	Reducing engineer access to servers by using remotely started scripts
o	Orchestrator runbooks to simplify common maintenance tasks
o	Auto remediation runbooks triggered by SCOM alerts
o	Automated patching and deployment scripts
o	Scripts for On-Call Engineers to collect information needed for troubleshooting

•	Azure automation and deployment
o	Developing Azure cloud services in C#
o	Automating deployment of cloud services and VMs
o	Managing Azure based alerting and ticketing systems

positions.title: Service Fabric Engineer/Developer and Problem Analyst
positions.description:
Maintaining and supporting System Center Orchestrator 2012 and other internal tools
Developing scripts and Orchestrator runbooks for automation and server auditing
Problem analysis of servers for Post Incident Reviews or pro-active investigations

positions.title: Outlook.com Exchange Operations Engineer
positions.description: Exchange Operations for the largest Microsoft Exchange implementation in the world.

positions.title: Tier 3 Exchange Escalation Engineer
positions.description: Providing back-end server support for the largest Microsoft Exchange mail environment in the world.

positions.title: Tier 2 Technical Lead for Exchange Online
Field Support Technician
positions.description: Performed on-site network, server, printer, and workstation repairs to 16 H&R Block retail locations in the Bellevue area.
